newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - KAIJA H1 PROFIT 415,339 LATS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - KAIJA H1 PROFIT 415,339 LATS.

text.p: Fish cannery Kaija said on Thursday that its first-half net profit was 415,339 lats.
It said in a statement that its first-half turnover was 5.999 million lats and that its gross profit was 995,645 lats.
The fish cannery, on the official list of the bourse, had production expenses of 500,399 lats and administrative costs of 415,196 lats.
The profit before extraordinary items and taxes was 420,652 lats.
The fish cannery also had assets of 9.70 million lats versus 10.26 million lats at the start of 1997.
The company had long-term debts of 50,137 lats versus 174,949 lats at the start of the year and short-term debts of 2.41 million lats versus 3.76 million lats.
